findings.body: The existing capture guard marks its own lineage poisoned for duplicate or foreign input before reaching parkPending. The new private mailbox receives only a successful first park. Its duplicate guard cannot observe the rejected second capture. It can preserve the initial handle through afterOriginal and reach the private header/read gates even though legacy lineage already became ineligible.
findings.fix: Propagate exact legacy lineage invalidation into the one private mailbox, or require equivalent private one-way proof of original lineage success before take. Leave the original g1/token lifecycle and count action intact. A later public frame check alone cannot prevent the early copy/read.

findings.body: The Source preparation helper reads and parses the fixed delta at module initialization. S09 and S10 import it even for pending overlay OFF. This makes OFF fixture initialization perform a new synchronous read and depend on successful parsing of private DATA before any pending transform is selected.
findings.fix: Defer the fixed delta read and parse to the first selected pending transform. Preserve the exact named site and inverse checks.

findings.body: The bounded adapter now limits request enrollment and response enrollment per lease. The responseLeases guard silently returns on a second attachment and retains the first accepted metadata. The duplicate cannot invalidate the cell through the response duplicate branch because the guard runs first.
findings.fix: Preserve the one-enrollment cap and terminally invalidate ambiguous duplicate attachment. Exercise the exact binding absence of a private marker as required by the focused ruling. Preserve original g1 behavior.
